MVCT.description: Moving Load Analysis Control (MVCT). A single-instance control record (key is always 1); POINT/iIGP select the influence-line point strategy, the bREAC/bDISP/bFM/bL check-boxes plus their bRG/bDG/bFG/bLG flags drive which result groups and group-name fields apply, and the trailing RUSSIA-code fields apply only when the model's moving-load code is RUSSIA.

METHOD.description: Analysis method for moving load influence. Enum (case-insensitive): EXACT, QUICK, PIVOT.

POINT.description: Load point selection. Enum (case-insensitive): INF (influence-line dependent point), ALL (all points).

iIGP.description: Influence generating points mode. 0 = number of unit loads per line element (uses iIGPN); 1 = fixed distance between points (uses DIST).

iIGPN.description: [iIGP!=1] Number of unit-load division points per line element.

PLATE.description: Calculation position for plate elements. Enum (case-insensitive): CENTER (element center), NODAL (center + nodal).

bCONCURRENT.description: Calculate concurrent forces for plate elements.

FRAME.description: Calculation position for frame elements. Enum (case-insensitive): NORMAL, AXIAL (normal + concurrent force/stress).

bCSTRCALC.description: Calculate combined stress for frame elements.

bCONCLINK.description: Calculate concurrent force of elastic/general links.

bRG.description: Reaction result scope. false = all; true = restrict to structure group RGN (sets ReacFilter=1).

RGN.description: [bREAC && bRG] Structure group name for reaction results; must be an existing group. Ignored (may be empty) otherwise.

bDG.description: Displacement result scope. false = all; true = restrict to structure group DGN (sets DispFilter=1).

DGN.description: [bDISP && bDG] Structure group name for displacement results; must be an existing group. Ignored (may be empty) otherwise.

bFG.description: Force/moment result scope. false = all; true = restrict to structure group FGN (sets ForcFilter=1).

FGN.description: [bFM && bFG] Structure group name for force/moment results; must be an existing group. Ignored (may be empty) otherwise.

bLG.description: Elastic/general link result scope. false = all; true = restrict to boundary group LGN (sets LinkFilter=1).

LGN.description: [bL && bLG] Boundary group name for elastic/general link results; must be an existing group. Ignored (may be empty) otherwise.

MATTYPE.description: [CODE=RUSSIA] Material type for dynamic factor (main). Applies only when the moving-load code is RUSSIA.

BRIDGETYPE.description: [CODE=RUSSIA] Bridge type for dynamic factor (main). Applies only when the moving-load code is RUSSIA.

AKMATTYPE.description: [CODE=RUSSIA] Material type for dynamic factor (AK loading). Applies only when the moving-load code is RUSSIA.

AKBRIDGETYPE.description: [CODE=RUSSIA] Bridge type for dynamic factor (AK loading). Applies only when the moving-load code is RUSSIA.

MINFACTS2.description: [CODE=RUSSIA] Minimum lane factor (s2). Applies only when the moving-load code is RUSSIA.

MAXV.description: [CODE=RUSSIA] Maximum number of successive vehicles. Applies only when the moving-load code is RUSSIA.

MAXSPACE.description: [CODE=RUSSIA] Maximum spacing between trains. Applies only when the moving-load code is RUSSIA.

INCV.description: [CODE=RUSSIA] Increment of moving vehicle at variable spacing. Applies only when the moving-load code is RUSSIA.
